name: GradReg
summary: Implemented explicit Gradient Regularization in a Dr.GRPO pipeline; found it generalizes well, but collapses into repetitive loops. Traced the cause to uniform regularization via mechanistic analysis, & redesigned it as a depth-scaled regularization that addresses the collapse and further improves OOD generalization.

name: GradMem
description: Learning to write context into memory at test time
summary: An alternate form of memory compression that involves test-time Gradient Descent to continually 'bake in' knowledge into the model.

name: Power Sampling
description: Replicating RL's policy sharpening at inference
summary: Inference time sampling technique using a power distribution and MCMC approximations that aims to match the effects of RL on a model's policy.

name: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning
description: Performing SDFT on domain specific knowledge
summary: Investigating the efficacy of SDFT on OOD tasks - specifically on corporate specific information.
